name: Economy Configuration and Simulation Foundation
product_reason: A tunable, validated economy source of truth is required before energy, boosters, continues, daily rewards, reward doubling, or starter offers can be balanced safely for retention and commercialization.
objectives: Define a versioned economy catalog for currencies, energy, booster costs, continue costs, and reward sources
Add pure deterministic simulations for earn-spend loops, refill cadence, reward cadence, and progression affordability
Reject negative balances, duplicate grants, unreachable progress, and configurations that force a purchase to continue
Compare proposed values with the current prototype through reports before making the new catalog authoritative
Preserve existing player saves and keep all values locally testable without a store, ad, analytics, backend, or remote-config SDK
boundary: Configuration, validation, and offline simulation only. No IAP or ad SDK, offer UI redesign, analytics integration, live-ops backend, Chapter 2 content, or silent mutation of existing player balances.
